summary_en: RECOMM acquired all issued shares of Tomiya Co., Ltd. on September 4, 2026, with a stock exchange effective September 7, 2026, completing Tomiya's acquisition of 4,891 shares (100% ownership) through stock transfer and simplified share exchange, with 865,000 treasury shares issued as consideration.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Acquisition of All Shares of Tomiya Co., Ltd. (Subsidiary Acquisition) and Effectiveness of Simplified Share Exchange (Complete Subsidiary Acquisition)
translation_en_brief:
RECOMM Co., Ltd. completed the acquisition of all issued shares of Tomiya Co., Ltd., a stationery and office equipment distributor based in Akita Prefecture, through a combination of stock transfer and simplified share exchange procedures. The stock transfer was executed on September 4, 2026, and the simplified share exchange became effective on September 7, 2026, resulting in Tomiya becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of RECOMM.

The transaction involved the acquisition of 4,891 shares, comprised of 3,906 shares through direct stock transfer and 985 shares through simplified share exchange. RECOMM issued 865,000 of its own treasury shares as consideration, without issuing new shares. The acquisition price was determined with reference to a valuation by third-party appraiser Univis Consulting but remains undisclosed due to a confidentiality agreement with the seller.

Tomiya, founded in 1797 and incorporated in 1965, operates a wholesale business in office supplies, stationery, furniture, and related equipment. RECOMM's board of directors approved the transaction on August 17, 2026. The simplified share exchange procedure allowed RECOMM to proceed without obtaining shareholder approval, as permitted under the Company Law. The impact on RECOMM's consolidated results for the fiscal year ending September 2026 is expected to be minimal.
